question: Which deities and groups are to be situated in the prescribed ritual arrangement?
premises: The world guardians and their weapons are included.
The group of eight beginning with the Vasus is included.
Vāstu is included as situated in the arrangement.
inference: Therefore the world guardians with their weapons, the group of eight beginning with the Vasus, and Vāstu are to be situated there.
uncertainties: The precise syntactic role of saṃsthito in relation to all listed items is compressed.
plain_english: The world guardians with their weapons, the group of eight beginning with the Vasus, and Vāstu are to be situated there.
